description: This is a Python source file implementing a custom logger for Braintrust integration within the litellm project. It defines the BraintrustLogger class that handles logging success and failure events, manages project IDs, and communicates with external Braintrust API endpoints asynchronously and synchronously.

classes.name: BraintrustLogger
classes.description: A custom logger class for sending success and failure events to Braintrust API, extending the CustomLogger base class.
